audit.rule: Every evidence path must exist in this branch. Product-owned source absent from this owner worktree is contract-only and cannot inherit a consumer classification from another branch. migrated-v2 additionally requires runtime use of WalletConnectionCoordinator, distinct Gateway v2 route evidence, and visible installed/browser platform evidence. An EVM-only MetaMask adapter connection is not Product Session migration evidence.

meaning.registry-ready: The central v2 registry and shared contract tests cover the product. This is not product-runtime migration evidence.
meaning.shared-sdk-v1: Current product source imports @ynx-chain/wallet-auth but still builds the v1 request/session contract.
meaning.legacy-direct: Current product source constructs or opens Wallet URLs outside the v2 router.
meaning.contract-only: Only a registry/integration contract was found; no v2 runtime consumer was found.
meaning.migrated-v2: Product runtime imports and executes WalletConnectionCoordinator over the v2 recovery client with platform evidence. No product currently meets this state.

integrationRule: A product may change migrated to true only when its runtime uses WalletConnectionCoordinator, its Gateway uses the v2 routes, and the required installed or browser flow evidence exists. Lower-level provider discovery, MetaMaskEvmConnectionAdapter, or RecoverableProductSessionClient alone cannot satisfy the common-component, Product Session, or Gateway evidence requirements.
